title: The Bomb Under the Table
intro: You are about to watch a short film, shot by shot. It takes place in a small cafe.
style: Cinematic film still, 35mm film, soft warm afternoon light, shallow depth of field, realistic, high detail.

characters.woman: a young woman with short black hair wearing a red coat
characters.man: a middle-aged man with a short gray beard wearing a navy sweater

s1_establish.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a small cozy cafe with wooden tables on a sunny afternoon. {woman} and {man} sit at a corner table, smiling and chatting over two cups of coffee.
s1_establish.description: Wide shot of a cozy cafe. A woman in a red coat and a bearded man sit at a corner table, smiling and chatting over coffee.

s2_reveal.prompt: Low-angle close-up under a wooden cafe table: a black metal bomb with tangled red and blue wires and a glowing red digital countdown timer is taped beneath the tabletop, the legs of two seated people visible beside it.
s2_reveal.description: Close-up under their table: a bomb with a glowing red digital countdown timer is taped beneath the tabletop.

s2_filler.prompt: Low-angle close-up under a wooden cafe table: a brown leather handbag resting on the wooden floor next to two pairs of shoes, sunlight on the floorboards.
s2_filler.description: Close-up under their table: a handbag rests on the floor next to the two people's shoes.

s3_woman.prompt: Medium shot of {woman} laughing and slowly stirring her coffee with a spoon, relaxed, sitting at a wooden cafe table.
s3_woman.description: Medium shot: the woman laughs and stirs her coffee, relaxed.

s4_man.prompt: Medium shot of {man} telling a funny story with animated hand gestures, smiling, sitting at a wooden cafe table.
s4_man.description: Medium shot: the man tells a funny story with animated gestures.

s5_clock.prompt: Close-up of a round vintage wall clock in a cafe, the second hand moving steadily, warm light.
s5_clock.description: Close-up of the cafe's wall clock, the second hand ticking.

s6_explosion.prompt: Wide shot of a small cafe: a sudden huge explosion bursts from a corner table, fire, smoke and debris flying, windows shattering.
s6_explosion.description: A sudden explosion erupts from the couple's table, fire and debris everywhere.

questions.text: Based only on what you have seen so far, how do you think this scene will end?

options.calm: The two people finish their conversation and leave peacefully; nothing bad happens.
options.escape: Something dangerous happens, but they get away unharmed.
options.harm: Something dangerous happens and they get hurt.

probe_facts.question: Is there a bomb or explosive device visible in this shot?
Is there an explosion visible in this shot?
